title: President Murmu Confers Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships & Awards on 115 Artists
summary: President Droupadi Murmu conferred Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships (7 artists) and Puraskar awards for 2024-25 on 115 artists.

blocks.content: President Droupadi Murmu conferred Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowships (7 artists) and Puraskar awards for 2024-25 on 115 artists.

items: **Fellowship Winners (7):** Ramlal Bareth, A V Anand, Rita Ganguly, Puru Dadheech, Chittaranjan Jyotishi, Pasumarthi Rattaiah Sarma, Sudharani Raghupathy.
**Prize Cash:** Akademi Fellowship (₹3 lakh + Tamrapatra); Akademi Award (₹1 lakh + Tamrapatra).
